question: Why does vehement striking function as the ground for supreme satisfaction?
premises: A state of being struck is present.
This striking serves as the cause of supreme satisfaction.
inference: Vehement striking is identified as the causal basis for supreme satisfaction.
uncertainties: The subject undergoing the striking is not explicitly named in this verse and relies on context.
plain_english: When being struck vehemently, it is so because this serves as the cause of supreme satisfaction.
